Japanese macaques network, part of the Koblenz Network Collection =========================================================================== This directory contains the TSV and related files of the moreno_mac network: This directed network contains dominance behaviour in a colony of 62 adult female Japanese macaques (Macaca fuscata fuscata). A node represents a macaque and a directed edge A → B represents dominance of macaque A over macaque B.
